entries.title: Fix in-app update install
items: Installing an update now replaces the portable file and restarts Luma after download finishes

entries.title: Keep the main window open
items: Hotkeys no longer close the settings window; it stays open after capture
Closing the window yourself keeps Luma in the tray, with a short reminder at the bottom of the screen

entries.title: Faster results, startup & in-app updates
items: Translation and Dictionary show text immediately while pronunciation loads in the background
Option to start Luma automatically when the computer starts
Checks GitHub Releases on startup and can install the update inside the app

entries.title: Ask AI polish, markdown & update check
items: Ask AI popup matches Dictionary (title bar + close button)
Ask AI replies render Markdown (headings, lists, code, tables)
Home screen scrolls and groups actions more clearly
Update check uses the correct GitHub repo (Luma-ai-translator)

entries.title: Ask AI, Dictionary & Updates
items: Ask AI — type a question in a popup near your cursor and chat with Gemini
Dictionary — look up words or sentences via Alt+D
Check for updates from GitHub Releases inside Settings
What's New changelog inside the app

entries.title: Luma polish
items: Replace Selection and Fix Grammar workflows
Default models and language defaults updated
